data.description: User j.okafor (Finance) reported a suspicious email with subject "Invoice overdue". The email body contains the link hxxps://payroll-update[.]example-billing[.]net/login and an attachment named invoice_2207.xlsm with SHA256 hash 9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08. User clicked the link on a personal device; it is unsure whether the corporate laptop was also used. Reported 2026-07-20 08:41 local time.
data.title: Suspicious Email Reported: Invoice Overdue with Malicious Link and Attachment
